description: thread.rs handle_thread_changes line 103: includes 'updatedProperties' in the response. RFC 8621 §3.2 says Thread/changes is 'a standard /changes method as described in [RFC8620], Section 5.2'. RFC 8620 §5.2 defines the changes response fields and does NOT include updatedProperties. The code comment claims 'RFC 8621 §3.2: SHOULD return ["emailIds"]' but §3.2 contains no such language. Similarly, email.rs handle_email_changes (line 140), identity.rs handle_identity_changes (line 99), and submission.rs handle_submission_changes (line 122) all add 'updatedProperties': null to non-Mailbox changes responses where it is undefined. Only Mailbox/changes (RFC 8621 §2.2) is specified to have this field.
title: Thread/changes returns non-standard updatedProperties field
